name: List
description: Displays item collections with built-in selection and actions.

notes: Uses listbox and option roles for composite list navigation
Supports interactive items with keyboard navigation
Proper ARIA labels for selection states

contract.nativeProps: Native div attributes and ARIA reach the root; role can override the default for presentational compositions.
contract.ref: HTMLDivElement augmented with List navigation methods.
contract.state: Selection is consumer-owned through Item selected and callbacks. Keyboard focus/highlight is distinct from selection. highlighted triggers scrolling to an item already marked data-highlighted; it is not a selection setter.
contract.layout: Use a single content wrapper for stacked Title and Desc. Media and Actions occupy separate row slots; resize media through Item styles.media.
contract.composition: Compose Item with leading Media, one stacked text region, and Actions. Do not put arbitrary direct text parts into separate columns when a stacked label is intended.
contract.accessibility: Name the listbox. Item defaults to role="option" with aria-selected; Enter/Space activate eligible rows. Use role="presentation" when a containing component already owns listbox semantics.

Item.nativeProps: Div attributes/events reach the row and are composed with keyboard/focus behavior.
Item.composition: Use onClick for row activation; events from nested controls keep their own interaction. selected sets aria-selected. focusable={false} disables row focus, useful for virtual-focus integrations.

examples.name: Stacked list row
examples.description: Title and description share one text column; selection is owned by the consumer.
